skills.MoveByDisplacement: Move the grasped object by a relative displacement
skills.Place: Place an object at a specified pose
skills.Toggle: Toggle (press/click) an object with the gripper (requires empty gripper).
skills.Beat: Beat or tap an object with a tool (possibly multiple times).
skills.Pour: Pour contents from one container into another.
skills.GrabTogether: Use both arms to grab an object together.
skills.Handover: Pass an object from one arm to another.
skills.Hang: Hang an object onto a target (e.g., rack, hook).
skills.Open: Open an articulated object (e.g., laptop, microwave).
skills.Scan: Scan an object with a scanner.
skills.Shake: Shake an object (optionally a number of times and/or orientation).
skills.Stamp: Stamp a target with a stamp.

conditions.Grasped: Check if the object is currently held by the robot.
conditions.AtPos: Check if object is at given pose.
conditions.HeldByArm: Check if object is held by specified arm.
conditions.Toggled: Check if the object has been toggled (e.g., button pressed/clicked).
conditions.Beaten: Check if the object has been beaten by a tool enough times.
conditions.ContentsIn: Check if contents are in the given container.
conditions.BothArmsFree: Check if both arms are free (not holding anything).
conditions.Hung: Check if the object is hanging from the target (e.g., a rack).
conditions.Opened: Check if the object is open (for articulated objects).
conditions.Scanned: Check if the object has been scanned by the scanner.
conditions.Shaken: Check if the object has been shaken (enough times, in the correct way).
conditions.On: Check if one object is on top of another.
conditions.Stamped: Check if the stamp has been stamped on the target.
